items.question: Trong câu "Scope is the project boundary: what will be done, and just as importantly, what will NOT be done.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope is the project boundary: what will be done, and just as importantly, what will NOT be done.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dɚ.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "Project boundary" = ranh giới dự án, cho biết đâu là trong và ngoài phạm vi; "set boundaries" = đặt giới hạn.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dɚ.i/ (noun): a dividing limit. The "project boundary" shows what is in and out of scope; "set boundaries" means set limits.

items.question: Trong câu "The second half is almost always omitted.", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The second half is almost always omitted.", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /oʊˈmɪt/ (động từ): bỏ sót, lược đi. Danh từ: omission (sự bỏ sót). Phần "không làm gì" của phạm vi thường bị bỏ sót.
items.explanationEn: omit /oʊˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. The noun is "omission"; the "what we will not do" part is often omitted.

items.question: Trong câu "A scope document that only lists what will be built leaves everything unmentioned as contested ground — the customer assumes it is included, the team assumes it is not.", từ "contested" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A scope document that only lists what will be built leaves everything unmentioned as contested ground — the customer assumes it is included, the team assumes it is not.", what does "contested" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contested /kənˈtes.tɪd/ (tính từ): bị tranh chấp. "Contested ground" = vùng tranh chấp; động từ "contest" = tranh cãi, phản đối (vd. contest a decision).
items.explanationEn: contested /kənˈtes.tɪd/ (adjective): disputed between sides. "Contested ground" is disputed territory; the verb "contest" means to dispute.

items.question: Trong câu "A scope document that only lists what will be built leaves everything unmentioned as contested ground — the customer assumes it is included, the team assumes it is not.", từ "unmentioned" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A scope document that only lists what will be built leaves everything unmentioned as contested ground — the customer assumes it is included, the team assumes it is not.", what does "unmentioned" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unmentioned /ʌnˈmen.ʃənd/ (tính từ): không được nhắc tới. Tiền tố "un-" + mentioned (được nhắc đến); điều gì không ghi ra sẽ bị mỗi bên hiểu một kiểu.
items.explanationEn: unmentioned /ʌnˈmen.ʃənd/ (adjective): not referred to at all. "Un-" + "mentioned"; anything not written down gets interpreted differently by each side.

items.question: Trong câu "Four sources of scope slippage:", từ "slippage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four sources of scope slippage:", what does "slippage" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a gradual drift from the plan
items.explanation: slippage /ˈslɪp.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): sự trượt, chệch dần. "Schedule slippage / scope slippage" = tiến độ / phạm vi bị trượt dần khỏi kế hoạch.
items.explanationEn: slippage /ˈslɪp.ɪdʒ/ (noun): a gradual drift from the plan. "Schedule slippage / scope slippage" describes gradual drift away from the plan.

items.question: Trong câu "Changes that bypass the process.", từ "bypass" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Changes that bypass the process.", what does "bypass" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bypass /ˈbaɪ.pæs/ (động từ): đi vòng qua, lách. "Bypass the process / security" = lách qua quy trình / bảo mật; danh từ "bypass" = đường tránh.
items.explanationEn: bypass /ˈbaɪ.pæs/ (verb): to go around. "Bypass the process / security" means going around it; as a noun, a road that avoids a town.

items.question: Trong câu "Nobody here is a villain; only a process is being ignored.", từ "villain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nobody here is a villain; only a process is being ignored.", what does "villain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: villain /ˈvɪl.ən/ (danh từ): kẻ xấu, kẻ phản diện. Ý câu: không ai cố tình làm xấu, chỉ là quy trình bị bỏ qua; đừng đổ lỗi cá nhân.
items.explanationEn: villain /ˈvɪl.ən/ (noun): a bad person to blame. Nobody is acting badly on purpose; only the process is being skipped, so avoid blaming people.

items.question: Trong câu "Nobody here is a villain; only a process is being ignored.", từ "ignore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nobody here is a villain; only a process is being ignored.", what does "ignore" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔːr/ (động từ): phớt lờ, bỏ qua. Đừng nhầm với "ignorant" (thiếu hiểu biết); danh từ: ignorance.
items.explanationEn: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔːr/ (verb): to pay no attention to. Do not confuse with "ignorant" (lacking knowledge); the noun is "ignorance".

items.question: Trong câu "The team adds nice-to-haves nobody asked for.", từ "nice-to-have" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team adds nice-to-haves nobody asked for.", what does "nice-to-have" (noun) mean?
options: thứ có thì tốt, không bắt buộc
items.explanation: nice-to-have /ˌnaɪs.təˈhæv/ (danh từ): thứ có thì tốt, không bắt buộc. Trái nghĩa "must-have" (bắt buộc phải có); hay dùng khi xếp ưu tiên tính năng.
items.explanationEn: nice-to-have /ˌnaɪs.təˈhæv/ (noun): an optional extra feature. The opposite of a "must-have"; common when prioritising features.

items.question: Trong câu "Twenty of those is a week of unplanned work.", từ "unplanned" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Twenty of those is a week of unplanned work.", what does "unplanned" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unplanned /ʌnˈplænd/ (tính từ): ngoài kế hoạch. "Unplanned work" = việc phát sinh ngoài kế hoạch; "unplanned downtime" = sự cố ngừng hoạt động bất ngờ.
items.explanationEn: unplanned /ʌnˈplænd/ (adjective): not in the plan. "Unplanned work" was never scheduled; "unplanned downtime" is an unexpected outage.

items.question: Trong câu "Two commonly confused concepts:", từ "confuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two commonly confused concepts:", what does "confuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (động từ): nhầm lẫn. "Confuse A with B" = nhầm A với B; "commonly confused" = hay bị nhầm lẫn.
items.explanationEn: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (verb): to mistake one for another. "Confuse A with B" means mistaking A for B; "commonly confused" means often mixed up.

items.question: Trong câu "Scope grows unnoticed and unapproved", từ "unnoticed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope grows unnoticed and unapproved", what does "unnoticed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unnoticed /ʌnˈnoʊ.t̬ɪst/ (tính từ): không ai để ý. "Go unnoticed" = diễn ra mà không ai để ý; đây là đặc trưng của scope creep.
items.explanationEn: unnoticed /ʌnˈnoʊ.t̬ɪst/ (adjective): without being seen. "Go unnoticed" means happen without anyone seeing, the hallmark of scope creep.

items.question: Trong câu "A conscious change, assessed and approved", từ "conscious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A conscious change, assessed and approved", what does "conscious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: conscious /ˈkɑːn.ʃəs/ (tính từ): có chủ ý. "A conscious decision" = quyết định có chủ ý; nghĩa khác là còn tỉnh (not unconscious).
items.explanationEn: conscious /ˈkɑːn.ʃəs/ (adjective): deliberate, done knowingly. "A conscious decision" is deliberate; another sense is being awake, not unconscious.

items.question: Trong câu "A conscious change, assessed and approved", từ "assess" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A conscious change, assessed and approved", what does "assess" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assess /əˈses/ (động từ): đánh giá. "Assess the impact / risk" = đánh giá tác động / rủi ro; danh từ: assessment.
items.explanationEn: assess /əˈses/ (verb): to evaluate. "Assess the impact / risk"; the noun is "assessment".

items.question: Trong câu "The goal is ensuring every change is seen, priced, and accepted at that price by someone with the authority to pay it.", từ "ensure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The goal is ensuring every change is seen, priced, and accepted at that price by someone with the authority to pay it.", what does "ensure" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ensure /ɪnˈʃʊr/ (động từ): đảm bảo. "Ensure that…" = đảm bảo rằng; dễ nhầm với "insure" (mua bảo hiểm).
items.explanationEn: ensure /ɪnˈʃʊr/ (verb): to make certain. "Ensure that…" means make certain; do not confuse with "insure".

items.question: Trong câu "The goal is ensuring every change is seen, priced, and accepted at that price by someone with the authority to pay it.", từ "price" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The goal is ensuring every change is seen, priced, and accepted at that price by someone with the authority to pay it.", what does "price" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: price /praɪs/ (động từ): định giá, tính chi phí. Động từ "price a change" = tính rõ chi phí (thời gian, tiền) của thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: price /praɪs/ (verb): to set the cost of. As a verb, "price a change" means working out its cost in time and money.

items.question: Trong câu "Specific enough to verify:", từ "verify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Specific enough to verify:", what does "verify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: verify /ˈver.ə.faɪ/ (động từ): kiểm chứng. Sản phẩm bàn giao phải cụ thể đến mức có thể kiểm chứng; danh từ: verification.
items.explanationEn: verify /ˈver.ə.faɪ/ (verb): to check it is true. A deliverable must be specific enough to check; the noun is "verification".

items.question: Trong câu "The most important part and the most frequently dropped:", từ "frequently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important part and the most frequently dropped:", what does "frequently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: frequently /ˈfriː.kwənt.li/ (trạng từ): thường xuyên. Viết tắt FAQ = Frequently Asked Questions (câu hỏi thường gặp).
items.explanationEn: frequently /ˈfriː.kwənt.li/ (adverb): often. As in FAQ, "Frequently Asked Questions".

items.question: Trong câu "Without them, acceptance becomes a negotiation at the worst possible moment — when the budget is gone.", từ "negotiation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without them, acceptance becomes a negotiation at the worst possible moment — when the budget is gone.", what does "negotiation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: negotiation /nəˌɡoʊ.ʃiˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): cuộc đàm phán. "Enter into negotiations" = bắt đầu đàm phán; động từ: negotiate.
items.explanationEn: negotiation /nəˌɡoʊ.ʃiˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a discussion to reach agreement. "Enter into negotiations"; the verb is "negotiate".

items.question: Trong câu "give it to two people separately and ask", từ "separately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "give it to two people separately and ask", what does "separately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: separately /ˈsep.ɚ.ət.li/ (trạng từ): riêng rẽ, tách biệt. Đưa tài liệu cho hai người đọc riêng để kiểm tra xem có hiểu giống nhau không.
items.explanationEn: separately /ˈsep.ɚ.ət.li/ (adverb): individually, apart. Two people read the document apart to see whether they understand it the same way.

items.question: Trong câu "If their answers differ, the document is not finished.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If their answers differ, the document is not finished.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪf.ɚ/ (động từ): khác nhau. "Differ from" = khác với; tính từ: different, danh từ: difference.
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪf.ɚ/ (verb): to be unlike. "Differ from"; the adjective is "different" and the noun "difference".

items.question: Trong câu "the exclusions section protects both sides, rather than being a trick for refusing customers.", từ "trick" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the exclusions section protects both sides, rather than being a trick for refusing customers.", what does "trick" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trick /trɪk/ (danh từ): mánh khóe. "Trick" có thể là mánh lừa (nghĩa xấu) hoặc mẹo hay ("a neat trick"); ở đây là nghĩa xấu.
items.explanationEn: trick /trɪk/ (noun): a deceptive tactic. "Trick" can be a deceptive tactic or a handy tip ("a neat trick"); here it is the negative sense.

items.question: Trong câu "the exclusions section protects both sides, rather than being a trick for refusing customers.", từ "refuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the exclusions section protects both sides, rather than being a trick for refusing customers.", what does "refuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: refuse /rɪˈfjuːz/ (động từ): từ chối. "Refuse a request" = từ chối yêu cầu; danh từ: refusal.
items.explanationEn: refuse /rɪˈfjuːz/ (verb): to say no to. "Refuse a request"; the noun is "refusal".

items.question: Trong câu "A customer benefits from knowing clearly what they are not buying just as much as what they are.", từ "benefit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A customer benefits from knowing clearly what they are not buying just as much as what they are.", what does "benefit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: benefit /ˈben.ə.fɪt/ (động từ): được lợi. "Benefit from something" = được lợi từ điều gì; danh từ "benefits" còn là phúc lợi nhân viên.
items.explanationEn: benefit /ˈben.ə.fɪt/ (verb): to gain an advantage. "Benefit from something"; the noun "benefits" also means employee perks.

items.question: Trong câu "A request that exists only as words in a meeting will be remembered differently by every attendee.", từ "attendee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A request that exists only as words in a meeting will be remembered differently by every attendee.", what does "attendee" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: attendee /əˌtenˈdiː/ (danh từ): người tham dự. Động từ attend (tham dự); đuôi "-ee" chỉ người nhận/tham gia như employee, trainee.
items.explanationEn: attendee /əˌtenˈdiː/ (noun): a person who attends. From "attend"; the "-ee" suffix marks a participant, as in employee, trainee.

items.question: Trong câu "Analyse the impact.", từ "impact" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analyse the impact.", what does "impact" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (danh từ): tác động, ảnh hưởng. "Impact analysis" = phân tích tác động; nghĩa gốc là cú va chạm.
items.explanationEn: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (noun): an effect or influence. "Impact analysis" studies the effects of a change; literally, a collision.

items.question: Trong câu "It must cover:", từ "cover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It must cover:", what does "cover" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌv.ɚ/ (động từ): bao gồm, đề cập. "The analysis must cover X" = phân tích phải bao quát X; "cover for someone" = làm thay ai.
items.explanationEn: cover /ˈkʌv.ɚ/ (verb): to include or deal with. "The analysis must cover X" means include X; "cover for someone" means do their work.

items.question: Trong câu "Regression too, not only the new feature", từ "regression" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Regression too, not only the new feature", what does "regression" (noun) mean?
options: kiểm thử hồi quy (lỗi cũ tái phát)
optionsEn: retesting old features for new bugs
items.explanation: regression /rɪˈɡreʃ.ən/ (danh từ): kiểm thử hồi quy (lỗi cũ tái phát). "Regression testing" = kiểm lại các chức năng cũ xem thay đổi mới có làm hỏng không.
items.explanationEn: regression /rɪˈɡreʃ.ən/ (noun): retesting old features for new bugs. "Regression testing" rechecks existing features so a change does not break them.

items.question: Trong câu "A small UI change may demand a data model change", từ "demand" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A small UI change may demand a data model change", what does "demand" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: demand /dɪˈmænd/ (động từ): đòi hỏi, cần đến. Ở đây "demand" = cần đến (require); nghĩa khác là đòi hỏi gay gắt. Danh từ: "supply and demand".
items.explanationEn: demand /dɪˈmænd/ (verb): to require. Here "demand" means require; it can also mean ask forcefully. Noun: "supply and demand".

items.question: Trong câu "What risk this change opens that is not yet in the register", từ "register" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What risk this change opens that is not yet in the register", what does "register" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: register /ˈredʒ.ə.stɚ/ (danh từ): sổ theo dõi, danh sách. "Risk register" = sổ đăng ký rủi ro; trong phần cứng "register" lại là thanh ghi.
items.explanationEn: register /ˈredʒ.ə.stɚ/ (noun): an official record list. A "risk register" logs risks; in hardware, a "register" is a small CPU storage slot.

items.question: Trong câu "Offer options, not just a number.", từ "offer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Offer options, not just a number.", what does "offer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: offer /ˈɑː.fɚ/ (động từ): đưa ra, đề xuất. "Offer options / a solution" = đưa ra các phương án / giải pháp; danh từ "job offer" = lời mời làm việc.
items.explanationEn: offer /ˈɑː.fɚ/ (verb): to present for consideration. "Offer options / a solution"; as a noun, a "job offer".

items.question: Trong câu "Who approves at what level must be agreed in advance.", từ "in advance" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who approves at what level must be agreed in advance.", what does "in advance" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in advance /ɪn ədˈvæns/ (cụm từ): từ trước. "Agree / pay in advance" = thỏa thuận / trả tiền trước.
items.explanationEn: in advance /ɪn ədˈvæns/ (phrase): beforehand. "Agree / pay in advance" means doing it beforehand.

items.question: Trong câu "Notify everyone affected.", từ "notify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Notify everyone affected.", what does "notify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: notify /ˈnoʊ.t̬ə.faɪ/ (động từ): thông báo. "Notify someone of something" = thông báo cho ai; danh từ: notification.
items.explanationEn: notify /ˈnoʊ.t̬ə.faɪ/ (verb): to inform officially. "Notify someone of something"; the noun is "notification".

items.question: Trong câu "Notify everyone affected.", từ "affected" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Notify everyone affected.", what does "affected" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: affected /əˈfek.tɪd/ (tính từ): bị ảnh hưởng. "Those affected" = những người bị ảnh hưởng; động từ "affect", khác danh từ "effect".
items.explanationEn: affected /əˈfek.tɪd/ (adjective): influenced by something. "Those affected" are the people influenced; the verb is "affect", unlike the noun "effect".

items.question: Trong câu "Including those who did not take part in the decision but will live with it.", từ "take part in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Including those who did not take part in the decision but will live with it.", what does "take part in" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: take part in /teɪk pɑːrt ɪn/ (cụm từ): tham gia vào. Đồng nghĩa "participate in"; "take part in a meeting" = tham gia cuộc họp.
items.explanationEn: take part in /teɪk pɑːrt ɪn/ (phrase): to participate in. Synonym of "participate in"; e.g. "take part in a meeting".

items.question: Trong câu "Including those who did not take part in the decision but will live with it.", từ "live with" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Including those who did not take part in the decision but will live with it.", what does "live with" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: live with /lɪv wɪð/ (cụm từ): chấp nhận chịu hệ quả. "Live with a decision" = phải chấp nhận hệ quả của quyết định; nghĩa đen là sống cùng ai.
items.explanationEn: live with /lɪv wɪð/ (phrase): to accept and cope with. "Live with a decision" means accept its consequences; literally, share a home.

items.question: Trong câu "Scope creep is dangerous because there is no single moment to catch it — it accumulates.", từ "accumulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope creep is dangerous because there is no single moment to catch it — it accumulates.", what does "accumulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (động từ): tích tụ dần. Danh từ: accumulation; "accumulated impact" = tác động cộng dồn.
items.explanationEn: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (verb): to build up gradually. The noun is "accumulation"; "accumulated impact" is the combined effect.

items.question: Trong câu "The team does unplanned work and nobody finds it odd", từ "odd" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team does unplanned work and nobody finds it odd", what does "odd" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: odd /ɑːd/ (tính từ): kỳ lạ, bất thường. "Find something odd" = thấy lạ; nghĩa khác "odd number" = số lẻ, "odd jobs" = việc lặt vặt.
items.explanationEn: odd /ɑːd/ (adjective): strange, unusual. "Find something odd" means strange; also "odd number" and "odd jobs".

items.question: Trong câu "Small-task accumulation is underway", từ "underway" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Small-task accumulation is underway", what does "underway" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: underway /ˌʌn.dɚˈweɪ/ (tính từ): đang diễn ra. "Work is underway" = công việc đang được tiến hành; cũng viết "under way".
items.explanationEn: underway /ˌʌn.dɚˈweɪ/ (adjective): already in progress. "Work is underway" means in progress; also written "under way".

items.question: Trong câu "Estimates are right yet you are consistently late", từ "consistently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Estimates are right yet you are consistently late", what does "consistently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: consistently /kənˈsɪs.tənt.li/ (trạng từ): liên tục, đều đặn. Tính từ: consistent (nhất quán); "consistently late" = lúc nào cũng trễ.
items.explanationEn: consistently /kənˈsɪs.tənt.li/ (adverb): every time, regularly. From "consistent"; "consistently late" means late every time.

items.question: Trong câu "Emergent work is consuming time, not bad estimates", từ "emergent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Emergent work is consuming time, not bad estimates", what does "emergent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: emergent /ɪˈmɝː.dʒənt/ (tính từ): phát sinh dần. "Emergent work" = việc tự phát sinh trong quá trình; khác "emergency" (khẩn cấp).
items.explanationEn: emergent /ɪˈmɝː.dʒənt/ (adjective): arising along the way. "Emergent work" appears along the way; not the same as "emergency".

items.question: Trong câu "Emergent work is consuming time, not bad estimates", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Emergent work is consuming time, not bad estimates", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsuːm/ (động từ): tiêu tốn. "Consume time / resources" = tiêu tốn thời gian / tài nguyên; trong hệ thống message, "consumer" đọc từ hàng đợi.
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsuːm/ (verb): to use up. "Consume time / resources"; in messaging systems a "consumer" reads from a queue.

items.question: Trong câu "The official request channel has been bypassed", từ "channel" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The official request channel has been bypassed", what does "channel" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: channel /ˈtʃæn.əl/ (danh từ): kênh tiếp nhận. "Request channel" = kênh tiếp nhận yêu cầu; "go through the proper channels" = đi đúng quy trình.
items.explanationEn: channel /ˈtʃæn.əl/ (noun): a route for communication. A "request channel" is the route requests must take; "go through proper channels".

items.question: Trong câu "Four preventions, in order of effectiveness:", từ "effectiveness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four preventions, in order of effectiveness:", what does "effectiveness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: effectiveness /ɪˈfek.tɪv.nəs/ (danh từ): mức độ hiệu quả. "Effectiveness" = làm đúng việc đạt kết quả; "efficiency" = làm ít tốn nguồn lực.
items.explanationEn: effectiveness /ɪˈfek.tɪv.nəs/ (noun): how well something works. "Effectiveness" is achieving the result; "efficiency" is using few resources.

items.question: Trong câu "Without a baseline there is nothing to compare against, so there is no creep — only confusion.", từ "baseline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without a baseline there is nothing to compare against, so there is no creep — only confusion.", what does "baseline" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the back line of a court
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (danh từ): đường cơ sở đã chốt. "Scope baseline" = phiên bản phạm vi đã được ký chốt, dùng làm mốc so sánh.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (noun): an agreed reference version. A "scope baseline" is the signed-off version used for comparison.

items.question: Trong câu "Without a baseline there is nothing to compare against, so there is no creep — only confusion.", từ "confusion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without a baseline there is nothing to compare against, so there is no creep — only confusion.", what does "confusion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: confusion /kənˈfjuː.ʒən/ (danh từ): sự rối loạn, mơ hồ. Động từ confuse; "cause confusion" = gây nhầm lẫn.
items.explanationEn: confusion /kənˈfjuː.ʒən/ (noun): a state of being unclear. From the verb "confuse"; "cause confusion".

items.question: Trong câu "Even when you decide to absorb a two-hour task for free, write it down.", từ "absorb" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Even when you decide to absorb a two-hour task for free, write it down.", what does "absorb" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take on the cost of
items.explanation: absorb /əbˈzɔːrb/ (động từ): gánh chịu, ôm lấy. "Absorb a cost / a task" = tự gánh chi phí / việc; nghĩa gốc là hấp thụ nước.
items.explanationEn: absorb /əbˈzɔːrb/ (verb): to take on the cost of. "Absorb a cost / a task" means taking it on yourself; literally, soaking up liquid.

items.question: Trong câu "Even when you decide to absorb a two-hour task for free, write it down.", từ "for free" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Even when you decide to absorb a two-hour task for free, write it down.", what does "for free" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: for free /fɔːr friː/ (cụm từ): miễn phí. "Do something for free" = làm không lấy tiền; đừng nhầm với "free time" (thời gian rảnh).
items.explanationEn: for free /fɔːr friː/ (phrase): without charge. "Do something for free" means without payment; not the same as "free time".

items.question: Trong câu "Review scope periodically with the sponsor.", từ "periodically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Review scope periodically with the sponsor.", what does "periodically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: periodically /ˌpɪr.iˈɑː.dɪ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): định kỳ. Tính từ periodic; "review periodically" = rà soát định kỳ (vd. mỗi hai tuần).
items.explanationEn: periodically /ˌpɪr.iˈɑː.dɪ.kəl.i/ (adverb): at regular intervals. From "periodic"; "review periodically" means at set intervals, e.g. every two weeks.

items.question: Trong câu "sometimes it is the right call for the relationship.", từ "the right call" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "sometimes it is the right call for the relationship.", what does "the right call" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: the right call /ðə raɪt kɔːl/ (cụm từ): quyết định đúng đắn. "Make the right call" = đưa ra quyết định đúng; "it is your call" = bạn quyết.
items.explanationEn: the right call /ðə raɪt kɔːl/ (phrase): a correct decision. "Make the right call" means decide correctly; "it is your call" means you decide.

items.question: Trong câu "But it must be a recorded DECISION, not an invisible habit.", từ "invisible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But it must be a recorded DECISION, not an invisible habit.", what does "invisible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: invisible /ɪnˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): vô hình, không ai thấy. Trái nghĩa "visible"; ý câu: việc làm miễn phí phải được ghi lại để mọi người thấy.
items.explanationEn: invisible /ɪnˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (adjective): unable to be seen. The opposite of "visible"; free work should be recorded so it can be seen.

items.question: Trong câu "A team carrying ten free tasks a month and then being judged as behind schedule is an injustice entirely preventable by record-keeping.", từ "injustice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A team carrying ten free tasks a month and then being judged as behind schedule is an injustice entirely preventable by record-keeping.", what does "injustice" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: injustice /ɪnˈdʒʌs.tɪs/ (danh từ): sự bất công. Tiền tố "in-" + justice (công lý); "do someone an injustice" = đối xử bất công với ai.
items.explanationEn: injustice /ɪnˈdʒʌs.tɪs/ (noun): unfair treatment. "In-" + "justice"; "do someone an injustice" means treat them unfairly.

items.question: Trong câu "A team carrying ten free tasks a month and then being judged as behind schedule is an injustice entirely preventable by record-keeping.", từ "preventable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A team carrying ten free tasks a month and then being judged as behind schedule is an injustice entirely preventable by record-keeping.", what does "preventable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: preventable /prɪˈven.t̬ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể phòng tránh. Động từ prevent (ngăn chặn); "preventable mistake" = lỗi có thể tránh được.
items.explanationEn: preventable /prɪˈven.t̬ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be avoided. From "prevent"; a "preventable mistake" could have been avoided.

items.question: Trong câu "Three common situations and how to handle them:", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three common situations and how to handle them:", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (động từ): xử lý, đối phó. "Handle a situation / a request" = xử lý tình huống / yêu cầu; danh từ "handle" = tay cầm.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (verb): to deal with. "Handle a situation / a request"; as a noun, a "handle" is the part you hold.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not argue about intent.", từ "intent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not argue about intent.", what does "intent" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (danh từ): ý định. Đồng nghĩa "intention"; lời khuyên: đừng cãi về ý định, hãy quay về tài liệu.
items.explanationEn: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (noun): what someone meant to do. A synonym of "intention"; do not argue about it, go back to the document.

items.question: Trong câu "If the document really is ambiguous, admit it.", từ "ambiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the document really is ambiguous, admit it.", what does "ambiguous" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: open to more than one meaning
items.explanation: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, đa nghĩa. Danh từ: ambiguity; trái nghĩa "unambiguous" (rõ ràng, một nghĩa).
items.explanationEn: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (adjective): open to more than one meaning. The noun is "ambiguity"; the opposite is "unambiguous".

items.question: Trong câu "If the document really is ambiguous, admit it.", từ "admit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the document really is ambiguous, admit it.", what does "admit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (động từ): thừa nhận. "Admit a mistake" = thừa nhận sai; nghĩa khác "be admitted to hospital" = nhập viện.
items.explanationEn: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (verb): to accept as true. "Admit a mistake"; another sense is "be admitted to hospital".

items.question: Trong câu "Winning an argument over an ambiguity costs more than it gains.", từ "ambiguity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Winning an argument over an ambiguity costs more than it gains.", what does "ambiguity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguity /ˌæm.bəˈɡjuː.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): chỗ mơ hồ. Tính từ ambiguous; "resolve an ambiguity" = làm rõ chỗ mơ hồ.
items.explanationEn: ambiguity /ˌæm.bəˈɡjuː.ə.t̬i/ (noun): an unclear point. From "ambiguous"; "resolve an ambiguity" means clear it up.

items.question: Trong câu "Winning an argument over an ambiguity costs more than it gains.", từ "gain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Winning an argument over an ambiguity costs more than it gains.", what does "gain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: gain /ɡeɪn/ (động từ): thu được lợi. Ý câu: thắng cuộc cãi lý thì mất nhiều hơn được; "gain trust" = có được lòng tin.
items.explanationEn: gain /ɡeɪn/ (verb): to obtain a benefit. Winning the argument loses more than it earns; also "gain trust".

items.question: Trong câu "an internal sponsor pushes extra scope with nothing extra given.", từ "internal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an internal sponsor pushes extra scope with nothing extra given.", what does "internal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: internal /ɪnˈtɝː.nəl/ (tính từ): nội bộ. Trái nghĩa "external"; "internal sponsor" = người bảo trợ trong công ty mình.
items.explanationEn: internal /ɪnˈtɝː.nəl/ (adjective): within the organisation. The opposite of "external"; an "internal sponsor" is within your own company.

items.question: Trong câu "an internal sponsor pushes extra scope with nothing extra given.", từ "push" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an internal sponsor pushes extra scope with nothing extra given.", what does "push" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: push /pʊʃ/ (động từ): ép, thúc ép. "Push extra scope" = ép thêm việc; trong git, "push" là đẩy code lên remote.
items.explanationEn: push /pʊʃ/ (verb): to pressure for. "Push extra scope" means pressing for more work; in git, "push" uploads commits.

items.question: Trong câu "Bring data, not emotion.", từ "emotion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bring data, not emotion.", what does "emotion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: emotion /ɪˈmoʊ.ʃən/ (danh từ): cảm xúc. Lời khuyên đàm phán: đưa số liệu thay vì cảm xúc; tính từ: emotional.
items.explanationEn: emotion /ɪˈmoʊ.ʃən/ (noun): a strong feeling. Negotiation advice: bring numbers rather than feelings; the adjective is "emotional".

items.question: Trong câu "Make the trade-off visible.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Make the trade-off visible.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɔːf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Make a trade-off between A and B" = đánh đổi giữa A và B.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɔːf/ (noun): a balance between two options. "Make a trade-off between A and B" means giving up some of one to get the other.

items.question: Trong câu "That is a legitimate change and deserves the same treatment as any other:", từ "legitimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is a legitimate change and deserves the same treatment as any other:", what does "legitimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legitimate /ləˈdʒɪt̬.ə.mət/ (tính từ): chính đáng. "A legitimate concern / request" = mối lo / yêu cầu chính đáng; nghĩa khác là hợp pháp.
items.explanationEn: legitimate /ləˈdʒɪt̬.ə.mət/ (adjective): reasonable and valid. "A legitimate concern / request" is valid; another sense is lawful.

items.question: Trong câu "That is a legitimate change and deserves the same treatment as any other:", từ "deserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is a legitimate change and deserves the same treatment as any other:", what does "deserve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deserve /dɪˈzɝːv/ (động từ): xứng đáng được. "Deserve attention / credit" = xứng đáng được chú ý / ghi nhận.
items.explanationEn: deserve /dɪˈzɝːv/ (verb): to be worthy of. "Deserve attention / credit" means being worthy of it.

items.question: Trong câu "That is a legitimate change and deserves the same treatment as any other:", từ "treatment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is a legitimate change and deserves the same treatment as any other:", what does "treatment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: treatment /ˈtriːt.mənt/ (danh từ): cách xử lý, đối xử. Ý câu: thay đổi từ đội cũng phải qua phân tích tác động như mọi thay đổi khác; nghĩa khác là điều trị.
items.explanationEn: treatment /ˈtriːt.mənt/ (noun): the way something is handled. Team-driven changes get the same process as any other; another sense is medical care.

items.question: Trong câu "If that cannot be answered, it is a technical preference rather than a need.", từ "preference" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If that cannot be answered, it is a technical preference rather than a need.", what does "preference" (noun) mean?
options: sở thích, ưu tiên cá nhân
items.explanation: preference /ˈpref.ɚ.əns/ (danh từ): sở thích, ưu tiên cá nhân. Động từ prefer; trong phần mềm "Preferences" còn là mục cài đặt.
items.explanationEn: preference /ˈpref.ɚ.əns/ (noun): a personal liking. From "prefer"; in software "Preferences" is also a settings menu.

items.question: Trong câu "The only way to do that without damaging the relationship is always arriving with alternatives and data, and never letting the first no happen at a point when no other option is left.", từ "alternative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The only way to do that without damaging the relationship is always arriving with alternatives and data, and never letting the first no happen at a point when no other option is left.", what does "alternative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alternative /ɑːlˈtɝː.nə.t̬ɪv/ (danh từ): phương án thay thế. "Offer an alternative" = đưa ra phương án khác; tính từ: alternative.
items.explanationEn: alternative /ɑːlˈtɝː.nə.t̬ɪv/ (noun): another possible choice. "Offer an alternative" means propose another option.

items.question: Trong câu "The only way to do that without damaging the relationship is always arriving with alternatives and data, and never letting the first no happen at a point when no other option is left.", từ "damage" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The only way to do that without damaging the relationship is always arriving with alternatives and data, and never letting the first no happen at a point when no other option is left.", what does "damage" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: damage /ˈdæm.ɪdʒ/ (động từ): làm tổn hại. "Damage a relationship / reputation" = làm tổn hại mối quan hệ / uy tín.
items.explanationEn: damage /ˈdæm.ɪdʒ/ (verb): to harm. "Damage a relationship / reputation" means harming it.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile does not remove scope management — it changes the mechanism.", từ "mechanism" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile does not remove scope management — it changes the mechanism.", what does "mechanism" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mechanism /ˈmek.ə.nɪ.zəm/ (danh từ): cơ chế. "Protection mechanism" = cơ chế bảo vệ; nghĩa gốc là bộ phận máy.
items.explanationEn: mechanism /ˈmek.ə.nɪ.zəm/ (noun): a way something works. "Protection mechanism" is how protection works; literally, machine parts.

items.question: Trong câu "Variable, freely changed outside the current sprint", từ "variable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Variable, freely changed outside the current sprint", what does "variable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: variable /ˈver.i.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể thay đổi. Tính từ "variable" = hay thay đổi; danh từ "variable" trong lập trình là biến.
items.explanationEn: variable /ˈver.i.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to change. The adjective means changeable; the noun in programming is a variable.

items.question: Trong câu "The sprint is inviolable and the backlog is ordered", từ "inviolable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The sprint is inviolable and the backlog is ordered", what does "inviolable" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: never to be broken or changed
items.explanation: inviolable /ɪnˈvaɪ.ə.lə.bəl/ (tính từ): bất khả xâm phạm. Từ violate (vi phạm) + in- + -able; sprint đang chạy không được thay đổi phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: inviolable /ɪnˈvaɪ.ə.lə.bəl/ (adjective): never to be broken or changed. From "violate"; a running sprint's scope must not be broken into.

items.question: Trong câu "an endlessly swelling backlog while the committed release date stays put.", từ "swell" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an endlessly swelling backlog while the committed release date stays put.", what does "swell" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: swell /swel/ (động từ): phình to. "A swelling backlog" = backlog phình ra không ngừng; nghĩa gốc là sưng lên.
items.explanationEn: swell /swel/ (verb): to grow bigger. "A swelling backlog" keeps growing; literally, to become swollen.

items.question: Trong câu "an endlessly swelling backlog while the committed release date stays put.", từ "stay put" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an endlessly swelling backlog while the committed release date stays put.", what does "stay put" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: stay put /steɪ pʊt/ (cụm từ): giữ nguyên chỗ. Thành ngữ thân mật: "stay put" = ở yên, không di chuyển.
items.explanationEn: stay put /steɪ pʊt/ (phrase): to remain unchanged. An informal idiom meaning to stay in the same place.

items.question: Trong câu "Backlog order lets you cut from the bottom, but if nobody tracks total remaining work against remaining time, the team reaches the release date before discovering half of it must go.", từ "remaining" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backlog order lets you cut from the bottom, but if nobody tracks total remaining work against remaining time, the team reaches the release date before discovering half of it must go.", what does "remaining" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: remaining /rɪˈmeɪ.nɪŋ/ (tính từ): còn lại. "Remaining work / time" = khối lượng / thời gian còn lại; động từ: remain.
items.explanationEn: remaining /rɪˈmeɪ.nɪŋ/ (adjective): still left. "Remaining work / time" is what is left; the verb is "remain".

items.question: Trong câu "the pragmatic approach is fixing the total volume (a story point count or a sprint count) while allowing the content to change.", từ "pragmatic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the pragmatic approach is fixing the total volume (a story point count or a sprint count) while allowing the content to change.", what does "pragmatic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pragmatic /præɡˈmæt̬.ɪk/ (tính từ): thực dụng, thực tế. "A pragmatic approach" = cách tiếp cận thực tế, chú trọng hiệu quả hơn lý thuyết.
items.explanationEn: pragmatic /præɡˈmæt̬.ɪk/ (adjective): practical and realistic. "A pragmatic approach" focuses on what works in practice rather than theory.

items.question: Trong câu "the pragmatic approach is fixing the total volume (a story point count or a sprint count) while allowing the content to change.", từ "volume" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the pragmatic approach is fixing the total volume (a story point count or a sprint count) while allowing the content to change.", what does "volume" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: volume /ˈvɑːl.juːm/ (danh từ): khối lượng. "Total volume of work" = tổng khối lượng việc; nghĩa khác: âm lượng, tập sách, ổ đĩa.
items.explanationEn: volume /ˈvɑːl.juːm/ (noun): an amount or quantity. "Total volume of work" is its amount; other senses are loudness, a book, a disk.

items.question: Trong câu "Four slip sources: vague requirements, bypassed process, gold plating, accumulating small tasks.", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four slip sources: vague requirements, bypassed process, gold plating, accumulating small tasks.", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, chung chung. "Vague requirements" = yêu cầu mơ hồ, nguồn gốc số một của trượt phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): unclear, not specific. "Vague requirements" are unclear and a leading cause of scope slip.

items.question: Trong câu "the PM prices the change and routes the decision.", từ "route" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the PM prices the change and routes the decision.", what does "route" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to send to the right person
items.explanation: route /ruːt/ (động từ): chuyển tới đúng người. "Route a decision / request to someone" = chuyển tới người có thẩm quyền; trong mạng là định tuyến.
items.explanationEn: route /ruːt/ (verb): to send to the right person. "Route a request to someone" sends it to the right owner; in networking, to route packets.

items.question: Trong câu "Creep signs: right estimates but consistent lateness, and users contacting developers directly.", từ "lateness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Creep signs: right estimates but consistent lateness, and users contacting developers directly.", what does "lateness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: lateness /ˈleɪt.nəs/ (danh từ): sự chậm trễ. Hậu tố "-ness" biến tính từ thành danh từ: late → lateness.
items.explanationEn: lateness /ˈleɪt.nəs/ (noun): the state of being late. The suffix "-ness" turns an adjective into a noun: late → lateness.

items.question: Trong câu "Scope management is making the boundary visible, and exclusions matter as much as inclusions.", từ "inclusion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope management is making the boundary visible, and exclusions matter as much as inclusions.", what does "inclusion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: inclusion /ɪnˈkluː.ʒən/ (danh từ): hạng mục được bao gồm. Trái nghĩa "exclusion"; động từ "include". Nghĩa khác: "diversity and inclusion".
items.explanationEn: inclusion /ɪnˈkluː.ʒən/ (noun): something included. The opposite of "exclusion"; another sense appears in "diversity and inclusion".

items.question: Trong câu "Agile swaps the protection mechanism for an inviolable sprint and an ordered backlog, but total remaining work still needs tracking.", từ "swap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile swaps the protection mechanism for an inviolable sprint and an ordered backlog, but total remaining work still needs tracking.", what does "swap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: swap /swɑːp/ (động từ): đổi, thay bằng. "Swap A for B" = đổi A lấy B; trong hệ điều hành "swap" là vùng hoán đổi bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: swap /swɑːp/ (verb): to exchange one for another. "Swap A for B" means replace A with B; in operating systems "swap" is memory paging space.
